summary: Strive, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 (Other Events) reporting its purchase of 32 bitcoin for ~$2.05M at an average price of $63,911/coin between June 2–7, 2026. The filing also updates cash, bitcoin holdings, STRC stock fair value, and share counts, including a 321,500-share increase in Class A common shares outstanding. No transaction terms, board recommendation, advisor, or special-situation mechanics are provided. This is a routine operational update on the company's bitcoin treasury strategy and ATM activity. There is no disclosed strategic review, restructuring, or other special-situation event.
